title: Direct-copy reference repository layout
objective: Implement the first reviewable repository layout refactor in engineering-backbone while preserving shared policy and legacy consumer behavior; publish a PR for incremental human inspection.
approved_sources: User authorization 2026-10-20 to create this refactoring PR
AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and policy/core.md at the recorded base

exclude: External product repositories and orchestration services
Content edits to mapped preserve_bytes entries

acceptance.description: All 495 baseline files have a unique explicit destination; historical records, historical fixtures, original provenance JSON, core invariants and dependency pins retain exact bytes.
The repository itself exposes the agreed product/reference paths, with native tool paths intact, and no invented product build or runtime claims.
The moved validator, trusted guards, compilers and dependency checks use the canonical paths, preserve rejection behavior, and regenerate exact reviewed fingerprints.
Actual direct-copy smoke succeeds; component/dependency/IDE/container placement and project-specific adoption/reset steps are documented.
Legacy Copier initial/update and historical regression tests remain meaningful; legacy compatibility is maintenance-only and has one canonical policy authority.

The previous trusted validator is exercised without candidate fallback or projection; its raw path incompatibility remains a visible blocked merge gate in the draft PR, with candidate negative policy tests separately passing.
The complete deterministic suite and independently frozen behavior/security reviews, triage and any necessary Delta are recorded; missing runtime/container evidence remains visible.
A scoped draft refactoring PR is published with its exact remote tree, blocked legacy trusted-base gate and real check state; no merge, release, downstream changes or auto-activation occurs.

manual_evidence: Independent read-only plan review before implementation
Complete 495-file mapping verification and historical-byte verification
Actual direct-copy and negative mutation tests, plus retained legacy initial/update tests; raw previous-validator path incompatibility recorded without fallback
Real container build/smoke or explicit unavailable status
Frozen base/head/patch digest for behavior and security Full review; separate triage; necessary Delta
Published PR URL, remote head/tree and actual check statuses

stop_conditions: Failed required check without diagnosed and documented disposition
Unresolved confirmed review finding before claiming readiness
Unexpected overwrite, ambiguous mapping or weakened local policy
Review budget exhausted without an accepted bounded closeout
forbidden_actions: Release, deploy or change repository access/settings
Changes to Artifaktory, Tars or Agent Orchestrator repositories
Claiming old historical PASS records, synthetic tests or structural validation prove new runtime qualification
